findings.finding: The FY27 volume guide starts from a forward order book 21% smaller in homes and value than a year earlier (4,206 homes / £1,197.2m vs 5,307 / £1,519.4m) and a private ex-bulk sales rate down to 0.49 from 0.52, while the market data since has worsened (Zoopla: 5-yr 75% LTV fix 5.2% at end-Sept vs 4% in January, sales agreed -9% y/y in the four weeks to 20 Sept) and Barratt Redrow's early-FY27 underlying private rate ran 0.53 vs 0.55 - so a completions guide at or below FY26's 9,695 and soft current trading is the likelier outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First-guide days: FY25 results 14 Oct 2025 +5.33% (with a £150m buyback launched); guide-sensitive interims 24 Mar 2026 -17.54% on margin; trading updates 1.6-7.9%. Peer read: Barratt Redrow trimmed its FY27 volume guide on 16 Sep 2026 and rose ~7.6% because profit beat - the sector has been rewarding 'less bad'.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the order book has been public since 11 Aug and the stock is ~5% below its pre-update level, but the late-Sept mortgage-rate step-up and the -9% Zoopla sales-agreed series postdate every sell-side FY27 model built off the August update; if the market had fully priced a lower guide, the 28 Sep sector rally would not have needed a full round-trip on rates to unwind and peers would not have rallied on Barratt's trimmed guide. Bar unsourced, so capped small.
findings.independence: Zoopla via Mortgage Professional (30 Sep 2026): https://www.mpamag.com/uk/news/general/uk-mortgage-rates-hit-3-year-high-as-housing-sales-fall/591679 ; Barratt Redrow FY26 results current trading (16 Sep 2026): https://www.directorstalkinterviews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/BTRW-full-year-results-2026.pdf

findings.finding: FY27 margin guide is exposed: FY26 adjusted operating margin fell to ~10% from 10.9% with incentives up to ~5% from 4.1%, profit landed at the bottom of the £320-330m range, and management flagged 'renewed inflationary pressure on build costs' (Barratt guides 3-4% FY27 build-cost inflation) - the line on which this stock fell 17.5% at the interims.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 24 Mar 2026 interims: -17.54% over the window when H1 profit undershot by ~10% and the full-year steer implied lower margins (https://www.ajbell.co.uk/group/news/bellways-shares-crumble-after-profit-margin-forecast-downgrades).
findings.why_not_priced: The FY26 margin is pre-released and priced; what is not is the FY27 margin guide, for which no consensus could be sourced. Barratt's 210bp gross-margin fall and 3-4% cost-inflation guide are public, but Bellway's own FY27 cost and incentive guide is not. Capped small because the bar is unsourced and the market has already de-rated the sector toward post-mini-budget valuations.
findings.independence: Barratt Redrow FY27 build-cost guide 3-4% (16 Sep 2026): https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/share-research/barratt-redrow-fy-results-profits-beat-softer-outlook ; shares the 11 Aug Bellway document with the volume finding but rests on different lines (margin, incentives, cost) and a different peer datum.

findings.finding: Total FY27 shareholder returns will be announced on the day and the £50m already launched is explicitly only the 'initial tranche', backed by year-end net cash of £157.7m (from £41.8m), adjusted operating cashflow above £850m and adjusted gearing under 5% - so a top-up above £50m plus the ordinary dividend is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 14 Oct 2025 FY results, when the first £150m buyback was launched: +5.33% over the window.
findings.why_not_priced: The existence of more returns is signalled by the company, so most of it is inside what was guided and sized toward 0; what is unpriced is the quantum, which the Board conditioned on 'prevailing market conditions' - a cautious board in a weaker market could also disappoint, hence the range crosses zero.
findings.independence: FY26 cash figures in the 11 Aug trading update: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/bellway--bwy/trading-update/9714330 ; Barratt Redrow reiterated a £400m FY27 return (sector precedent): https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/barratt-redrow-fy-completions-rise,-statutory-profits-up-48pc

findings.finding: Bellway is the first UK housebuilder to report since the government's 28 Sep 'Your First Home' scheme (20% equity loan, 2.5% deposit, new-build only, details at the 28 Oct Budget) - the deposit-support scheme Bellway itself publicly demanded in August - and the sector has since fully round-tripped the rally (BWY 1,948p on 9 Oct vs 2,068p on 25 Sep, after +10.3% on 28 Sep), so management's read on the scheme and the Budget is an unpriced sector-level statement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 28 Sep 2026: BWY +10.3% close-to-close on the scheme announcement on 5x normal volume (Yahoo tape), then -5.8% over the following 9 sessions as gilt yields rose (30-yr above 6%).
findings.why_not_priced: The scheme's upside was priced on 28 Sep and then given back entirely on rates, so the price now holds roughly zero for it; the first company to quantify early interest or deferral sets the tone. Cuts both ways: HL's analyst warned 'some buyers may simply choose to wait for more details, so sales are likely to remain subdued in the meantime', which is why the range is symmetric and the size small.
findings.independence: Bellway's own call for 'a Government-backed deposit support scheme for first-time buyers' (11 Aug 2026): https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/bellway--bwy/trading-update/9714330 ; IG preview noting the rally faded on mortgage costs (12 Oct 2026): https://ig.com/uk/news-and-trade-ideas/autumn-budget-2026-healey-s-first-test--uk-stocks-in-the-firing--261012
